title: Studio Success Momentum
scenario: Flag studios where the average critic_score of their games has increased for 4 consecutive releases.
tableSchema: developers (studio_name VARCHAR, game_id INT), ratings (game_id INT, critic_score NUMERIC), games (game_id INT, release_year INT)
hint: Use LAG(avg_score, 1) and LAG(avg_score, 2) etc., or a series of comparisons.
correctQuery: SELECT studio_name FROM (SELECT studio_name, avg_score, LAG(avg_score, 1) OVER(PARTITION BY studio_name ORDER BY release_year) as l1, LAG(avg_score, 2) OVER(PARTITION BY studio_name ORDER BY release_year) as l2, LAG(avg_score, 3) OVER(PARTITION BY studio_name ORDER BY release_year) as l3 FROM (SELECT d.studio_name, g.release_year, AVG(r.critic_score) as avg_score FROM developers d JOIN ratings r ON d.game_id = r.game_id JOIN games g ON d.game_id = g.game_id GROUP BY d.studio_name, g.release_year) t) t2 WHERE avg_score > l1 AND l1 > l2 AND l2 > l3;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE developers (studio_name VARCHAR, game_id INT); CREATE TABLE ratings (game_id INT, critic_score NUMERIC); CREATE TABLE games (game_id INT, release_year INT);
